# telnyx_rcs_agent_test_device (Resource)

A test device invited to an RCS agent, which can receive the agent's messages before launch.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_rcs_agent_test_device" "qa_phone" {
  agent_id     = telnyx_rcs_agent.alerts.id
  phone_number = "+13125550142"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) The agent id.
- `phone_number` (String) The +E.164 phone number of the test device.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `invite_status` (String) The status of the invitation to the device.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_rcs_agent_test_device.qa_phone <agent_id>/<id>
```
